3	// stays clear; furniture stands on the z51 row against the north wall. Focal piece: the dark oak bench (stairs as
4	// seats) with a standing lantern on each fence post and a barrel with a flower pot.
5	// Hanging lanterns sit under the ceiling along the lane (y9) so the floor is lit at night.
6	import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
7	
8	export function build(g) {
9	  const legend = {
10	    "F": "dark_oak_fence", // lantern posts
11	    "S": ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "north", half: "bottom" }], // bench seats, back to the north wall
12	    "B": "barrel", // service barrel
13	    "P": "flower_pot", // on the barrel top
14	    "L": ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }], // standing lantern on a fence post
15	    "h": ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }], // hanging lantern under the ceiling
16	  };
17	
18	  // x52..68 across (index 0 = x52), rows z51 then z52. y4: the floor furniture; the z52 lane stays clear.
19	  layers(g, [52, 4, 51], legend, [[
20	    "....F..BSSS.F....", // z51: post x56, barrel x59, bench x60..62, post x64
21	    ".................", // z52: lane
22	  ]]);
23	  // y5: the standing lanterns on the posts, a flower pot on the barrel
24	  layers(g, [52, 5, 51], legend, [[
25	    "....L..P....L....",
26	    ".................",
27	  ]]);
28	  // y9: hanging lanterns down the lane, under the ceiling
29	  layers(g, [52, 9, 51], legend, [[
30	    ".................",
31	    ".h....h....h...h.",
32	  ]]);
33	}
